jobs.description:
Goodwill Greater New York and Northern New Jersey (GWNYNJ) believes that the power of work and sustainable fashion is how we unlock the good in our communities. For over 100 years, we have helped people get jobs, stay employed, and progress in careers across New York and Northern New Jersey. We believe that diversity drives innovation and strengthens our workplace. We are committed to fostering our inclusive environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute fully. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities.
  
  

**Job Title:** Account Manager, Sales – Workforce1 Career Centers (Bronx: Fordham \& Hunts Point)
  
**Reports To:** Business Services Manager
  
**Location:** Bronx, NY (Fordham Hub \& Hunts Point Satellite)
  
**Travel Required:** Yes – throughout the five boroughs of New York City
  
  

Position Overview
  
The Sales Account Manager is responsible for business development and employer engagement on behalf of the Workforce1 Career Centers. This position focuses on building and maintaining strong relationships with employers across New York City to identify hiring needs, promote Workforce1 services, and connect businesses with qualified candidates.
  
The ideal candidate is a natural networker who thrives on relationship\-building, understands local labor market trends, and is passionate about helping employers meet their workforce needs while creating opportunities for jobseekers.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Business Development \& Employer Engagement
  
* Conduct proactive outreach to employers, industry associations, and local businesses to identify hiring needs and promote Workforce1 services.
* Develop and maintain long\-term partnerships with employers to drive repeat business and ongoing collaboration.
* Conduct labor market research to identify trends, new business openings, and in\-demand occupations across the five boroughs.
* Attend networking events, business expos, and community meetings to represent Workforce1 and build employer relationships.
* Maintain an up\-to\-date database of employer accounts and contacts within internal systems (e.g., Dynamics).


Partnership \& Collaboration
  
* Collaborate closely with the Recruitment and Career Services teams to ensure that employer job orders are filled with qualified candidates.
* Communicate employer hiring requirements clearly to the Recruitment team and monitor progress toward fulfillment.
* Partner with community\-based organizations, chambers of commerce, and business improvement districts (BIDs) to expand employer outreach.


Performance \& Reporting
  
* Meet or exceed monthly employer engagement and job order targets as set by SBS and internal management.
* Track and report all employer interactions, job orders, and placements in compliance with Workforce1 and SBS guidelines.
* Analyze data and labor market information to inform outreach strategies and identify new business opportunities.


Qualifications
  
* Business sales, relationship building or a related field preferred (or equivalent relevant experience).
* Minimum 3 years of experience in business development, sales, employer engagement, or workforce development.
* Strong understanding of labor market dynamics, employer needs, and NYC’s business ecosystem.
* Excellent communication, networking, and relationship management skills.
* Proven ability to meet goals and deliver results in a performance\-driven environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and CRM systems (Dynamics experience preferred).
* Willingness and ability to travel throughout New York City for employer visits and events.


Work Environment
  
This position operates in a fast\-paced, goal\-oriented environment requiring collaboration across multiple teams. The role supports both the Fordham (Hub) and Hunts Point Workforce1 Career Centers, with frequent travel across all five boroughs for employer meetings, events, and business development activities.
  
  

Equal Opportunity Statement
  
Goodwill NY/NJ and the Workforce1 Career Centers are equal opportunity employers committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, or any other protected status.
  
What We Offer
  
  

* Generous Time off policy to use when you need it
* Health, wellness and financial resources to help you achieve our personal goals
* Robust health benefits including medical, dental, vision, parental leaves and company sponsored life insurance
* Retirement matching programs and contributions
* Transit and commuter benefits


\#IND1
  
  

We believe in creating space for everyone to do their best work and have individual and collective impact. Field Account Manager, Pacific Northwest, Independent Sales Team
  
Job Posting
  
  

Do you love books? Are you passionate about sales, connecting readers with stories, building strong business relationships? Are independent bookstores your home away from home? If so, this might be the perfect job for you!
  
  

Simon \& Schuster is looking for a Field Account Manager on the Independent Bookstore Team based in the Seattle area to sell our complete list—Wholly\-Owned Children’s, Adult, Audio, and Distributed Client titles—to an account base of 35\+ independent bookstores in the Pacific Northwest region.

Simon \& Schuster, Inc. is a global publishing company with prominent imprints, celebrated for publishing award\-winning books for children and adults in multiple formats and categories.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Flagler Health is building the clinical operating system for modern musculoskeletal care.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We partner with MSK provider groups and specialty clinics to help them grow, operate more efficiently, and deliver better longitudinal care across patient acquisition, clinical workflows, and ongoing patient engagement. Our platform sits at the intersection of care delivery and clinic operations, helping providers capture more value across the full patient lifecycle.


We’ve recently raised our Series B and are entering our next phase of growth.


As Account Manager, you own a portfolio of Flagler's existing customer accounts and are responsible for growing them. You build trusted relationships with clinic and provider\-group stakeholders, understand their goals, and help them get more value from the platform over time. You partner with Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations to find where accounts can expand and to turn those opportunities into larger, longer\-term partnerships. Success in the role is measured by account growth and retention.  

What You'll Do

* Own a portfolio of existing accounts and carry a target for growth and retention.
* Build strong relationships with the decision\-makers and day\-to\-day users at each clinic or provider group.
* Learn each account's goals and workflows, and proactively surface ways they can get more value from the platform.
* Identify and close expansion opportunities within your accounts, from first conversation through signed agreement.
* Prepare proposals, pricing, and business cases that show the value of expanding.
* Lead regular account reviews and renewals, and keep customers engaged in between.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations to remove blockers and deliver on what you sell.
* Track account health and forecast growth accurately in the CRM.


Required Qualifications

* 5 to 7 years in account management, sales, or a customer\-facing revenue role, with a record of growing existing accounts.
* A consistent track record of hitting growth or retention targets.
* Strong relationship\-building, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Comfort with CRM and sales tooling, pipeline management, and data\-driven account planning.
* Ability to manage a portfolio of accounts and priorities at once without losing the details.


Preferred Qualifications

* Healthtech and enterprise experience, highly preferred.
* Experience growing existing customer accounts or expanding product adoption.
* Familiarity with revenue operations tooling and analytics.

**Our Values:**
---------------


This is what you can expect of your teammates at Flagler:

* **Owner:** We own our work like founders. We don't wait to be asked, and we pick up the problem nobody else has.
* **Builder:** We like making things from scratch. We don't need a playbook to start, and we'd rather ship a rough first version than wait on a perfect spec.
* **Fast:** We make quick decisions. We favor progress and respect process.
* **Transparent:** We communicate directly. We value merit and honesty, and we challenge assumptions, including our own.
* **Curious:** We explore new approaches and ask "why" often.


Compensation Range: $85K \- $120K

As an Associate Publisher Account Manager, U.S. \& Canada working on the SMB Publisher team in the NYC office you will play a vital role in focusing on optimizing existing relationships by upselling new initiatives to publishers and improving the metrics on their site.


Taboola products are leveraged by our publisher and media companies to drive advertising and audience acquisition while also streamlining the Editorial team's operations. To be effective with Taboola's customers, digital advertising or publisher/media client\-facing experience is highly valued. Yet, if you possess a strong Account Management background with a history of exceeding goals and retaining clients, we encourage your application.



You need to be naturally inquisitive and excited about the business value our customers are achieving with our products and services. We take pride in our professionalism, integrity, and ability to deliver real value to our clients. This is an exciting opportunity to play an important role in a very successful and rapidly growing company.

* BA/BS required
* 1\+ years of professional experience (client\-facing in the digital media /online publisher space preferred but not required)
* Proven record with upselling and meeting or exceeding quota
* Outstanding relationship management and customer service skills, with a customer centric mentality
* Very strong analytical skills to collect business intelligence by monitoring/identifying trends with data, including revenue projections and forecasting
* Highly motivated, proactive, dedicated and creative in order to pull all necessary resources for the client
* High attention to detail and well organized, thrives in a multitasking environment and adjusts and prioritizes accordingly
* Strong phone, email etiquette, and presentation skills
* Impeccable written and verbal communication skills
* You're a natural collaborator, able to work with anyone to reach a common goal
* Basic familiarity with front\-end web development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

### **Bonus points if you have:**


* Fluency in French

### **How you'll make an impact:**



As an Associate Publisher Account Manager, you'll bring value by:


* Managing and growing relationships with publisher clients
* Understanding client KPIs and identify upsell opportunities
* Monitoring and analyzing metrics and proactively take steps to improve performance
* Strategic planning and forecasting in alignment with revenue objectives
* Working closely with the Sales \& Product teams in order to become a valuable resource both internally and externally
* Actively participating with peers in a team\-oriented culture and assist other internal groups
* Being the expert on revenue optimization for your book of business and become a trusted advisor for clients based on knowledge of the the industry
* Helping identify trends through data analysis and market conditions to pinpoint highest value optimizations

### **Why Taboola?**



If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they'll tell you that they've been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They'll also share more about:


* Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; "You can copy anything from another business but you can't copy a company's culture."

* **Work with some of the biggest names:** Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Pinterest, Expedia and Honda.


**Ready to realize your potential?**



Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.\-



Learn more about \#TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, \& the Taboola Life Blog.

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.



Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola's powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. We self\-perform hard services while partnering with best\-in\-class soft service providers to offer custom facility and project management solutions to our clients. We focus on empowering our team with a high\-level of downstream accountability resulting in an agile and efficient service delivery.
In addition to our core facility and project management capabilities, our platform offers direct access to our Best\-in\-Class services including ESG, Security Consulting, Workplace Strategy, and Workplace Experience. **About the Role:**
As a CBRE Account Manager , you will oversee a small to medium\-sized team responsible for delivering all client commitments.


This is part of the Operations Management job function. They are responsible for coordinating staff functions and operations that support the organization’s goals and strategies.

**What You’ll Do:*** Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
* Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross\-train staff. Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.
* Consult with sales professionals to define basic project requirements. Investigate various approaches to attain end results. Inform the organization of potential risks and implement action plans to address them.
* Assist with the coordination of resources needed to service projects and build strategic operational plans.
* Responsible for the management of sales, and relationships with small to medium\-sized clients. Identify new sales opportunities and improvements within existing accounts.
* Monitor service level performance to ensure client service levels are met and exceeded. Present findings to Sr. Management.
* Prioritize open issues and tasks, working closely with both internal and client cross\-functional teams. Serve as a point of contact for key systems and processes for projects.
* Manage expectations of the client and project team regarding the scope of work and responsibilities. daily performance and ongoing delivery against contractual obligations
* Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Influence parties of shared interests to reach an agreement.
* Apply knowledge of own discipline and how own discipline integrates with others to achieve team and departmental objectives.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve day\-to\-day and moderately complex issues which may or may not be evident in existing systems and processes.

**What You’ll Need:*** Bachelor's Degree preferred with 3\-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention preferred.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to motivate team impact on quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the job discipline and department.
* In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.

**Why CBRE**
When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants. **Applicant AI Use Disclosure**
We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.  



  

New York Residents: CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience.

We are seeking a creative, analytical, and highly organized Digital Marketing Strategist \& Scheduler Intern to support our digital presence, content strategy, brand awareness, and audience growth. * Current college student, recent graduate, or early\-career professional interested in digital marketing, communications, branding, social media, analytics, or business development.

* Positive, professional attitude with a willingness to learn, receive feedback, and continuously improve.
* Resourceful and proactive, with the confidence to bring forward ideas, questions, and recommendations as a thought partner.

Experience with Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite/Ads Manager, SEO, email marketing platforms, digital advertising, public relations, or media outreach is a plus but is not required.

**What You Will Gain**

jobs.title: Sales & Business Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
$55,000 base \+ uncapped commission. About $70,000 a year at target.

You'll be the first voice new clients hear when they call MyHome, and the person who opens doors with the architects, designers and brokers who bring us our best projects. Half of this job is making every inbound lead feel looked after. The other half is building relationships that turn into work.

About MyHome

MyHome Renovation Experts has been renovating New York homes for over 25 years. We design, permit and build kitchens, bathrooms and full apartment renovations under one roof, with a showroom in Midtown where clients choose their materials. Every project carries a 10\-year warranty on labor and materials.

About the role

You'll report to our CEO. A year from now, success looks like this: every inbound lead answered quickly and tracked in HubSpot, a steady flow of about 12 meetings a month between our CEO and architects, designers and brokers, and a growing network of trade partners who know MyHome by name.

What you'll do

\* Own inbound leads: answer calls, web forms and emails, qualify them and book consultations

\* Keep HubSpot accurate, with every lead, call and next step logged

\* Build target lists of NYC architects, interior designers and real estate brokers

\* Reach out by phone, email and LinkedIn, and book introductory meetings for our CEO

\* Follow up after each meeting and keep relationships warm

\* Share a short weekly report on leads and meetings

What we're looking for

\* At least 1 year in sales, customer service, hospitality or an office role with heavy phone and email contact

\* Comfortable making cold calls and hearing "no"

\* Clear, professional written English

\* Experience keeping records in a CRM or similar tracking system

\* Able to work from our Midtown office (353 W 48th St) Monday to Friday

Nice to have

\* HubSpot experience

\* Interest in design, architecture, real estate or construction

\* Existing contacts among NYC architects, designers or brokers

Pay and benefits

\* $55,000 base salary

\* Commission on every meeting you book: $100 for each qualified meeting held with our CEO, and $150 for each meeting above 12 in a month

\* About $70,000 a year at target, and the commission has no cap

\* Paid time off

\* A structured first 90 days with hands\-on, paid training

How to apply

Apply here and answer the short screening question: write 3 to 4 sentences introducing MyHome to an architect you've never met. We read every one.

Pay: $55,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Paid training

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

* In 3 to 4 sentences, introduce MyHome Renovation Experts to an NYC architect you've never met, as if you were reaching out to book a meeting.

Ability to Commute:

* New York, NY 10036 (Preferred)

jobs.description:
KeyZoo is expanding, and we’re looking for motivated B2B Sales Representatives to help us secure new locations for our growing kiosk network.

Your job is simple: identify high\-traffic businesses, speak with owners and decision\-makers, present the KeyZoo opportunity, and secure signed location agreements.

What We Offer Our Location Partners

This is not just another sales pitch — the business owner makes money too.

KeyZoo installs and operates the kiosk while the host business receives:

20% of kiosk sales OR a $100 monthly guaranteed payment, depending on the agreement.

The business gets an additional revenue stream, an extra service for its customers, and potential additional customer traffic — with KeyZoo handling the kiosk operation.

Ideal locations include:

* Parking garages
* Supermarkets \& grocery stores
* Gas stations \& convenience stores
* Dry cleaners
* Smoke shops
* Hotels
* Office buildings
* High\-traffic retail businesses
* Multi\-location businesses and regional chains

Compensation – Build Recurring Income

For every qualified KeyZoo location you successfully bring into our network:

$150 when the location agreement is signed

PLUS

$30 per month for 12 months beginning once the kiosk is installed and active.

Total earning potential: $510 per location.

The more active locations you build, the more recurring monthly commission you can generate.

For example:

10 active locations \= $300/month

25 active locations \= $750/month

50 active locations \= $1,500/month

100 active locations \= $3,000/month

Plus your upfront signing commissions.

What You’ll Do

* Prospect and approach business owners and decision\-makers
* Conduct phone, email, and in\-person B2B outreach
* Present the KeyZoo kiosk opportunity
* Explain the revenue opportunity to potential location partners
* Negotiate and secure signed agreements
* Identify businesses with multiple locations and larger chains
* Follow up consistently with prospects
* Maintain and manage your sales pipeline
* Build long\-term relationships with location partners

Who We’re Looking For

We want someone who is confident, motivated, and knows how to close.

Previous B2B sales or business development experience is preferred.

You should be comfortable approaching business owners, getting in front of decision\-makers, following up, negotiating, and asking for the deal.

Experience in outside sales, merchant services, advertising, commercial real estate, retail partnerships, kiosks, or location acquisition is a plus.

If you want an opportunity where every location you close can create both immediate and recurring commission income, we want to hear from you.

Work Setting: Office \+ Field / B2B Sales

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
NJ/NY Gotham FC (“Gotham FC” or “the Club”) is a National Women’s Soccer League (“NWSL”) team representing New Jersey and New York. The team plays at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, NJ. At Gotham FC, we don’t just play soccer; we set trends, challenge the status quo, and lead with bold creativity. While our roots are grounded in the tradition of the beautiful game, everything else about us is fiercely original. We’re here to redefine expectations, break boundaries, and build something that hasn’t been done before. If you’re ready to push the limits and make an impact, you belong at Gotham FC. **The Role:**
Gotham FC is seeking an Inside Sales Representative (ISR) that will report to the Director of Sales. This role is designed for those passionate about sports and eager to develop their sales skills in a fast\-paced, competitive environment. Our ISRs reach their goals by phone prospecting, setting outside appointments, participating in sales/promotional events and prospecting at Gotham FC home matches as well as events. They are also responsible for delivering exceptional customer service, updating and maintaining account records, and other duties as assigned. This position will have set start and end dates. **Key Responsibilities:*** Sales Goals Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed established sales targets for season memberships (full season), group ticket packages, and other offerings.
* Outbound Sales Efforts: Actively engage in outbound sales efforts, including but not limited to prospecting, networking, and cold calling, to generate new business opportunities and build a robust client base.
* Lead Generation and Database Management: Use sales and service best practices to effectively manage lead generation, data capture, and database management to maximize sales potential.
* Customer Service Excellence: Provide exceptional service to all Season Members, group buyers, single\-game buyers, and new business prospects to ensure long\-term satisfaction and retention.
* Sales Strategy Development: Continuously develop and implement creative sales strategies and promotional ideas to generate new business and drive ticket sales.
* Collaboration and Team Culture: Work collaboratively with the sales team, fostering a supportive and motivated environment. Participate in regular sales meetings and training sessions.

 **Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
* Strong Work Ethic \& Competitiveness: A self\-starter with a positive attitude and a passion for achieving sales goals.
* Team Player: Ability to collaborate and work well within a team environment.
* Outbound Sales Comfort: Comfortable with making outbound cold calls.
* Career\-Oriented: A strong desire to start a career with a team offering significant growth opportunities.
* Professional Presentation: Demonstrates professionalism in both appearance and interactions with individuals at all organizational levels.
* Adaptability: Able to address challenges and adapt quickly in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

Proven Results\-Driven Approach: Demonstrated success in achieving or exceeding sales targets and driving results.  
* 

**Capability \& Other Characteristics:*** Legally authorized to work in the United States.

 **Location:**
Based at Gotham FC’s business office, which is located at 15 Exchange Place, Jersey City, New Jersey, on a hybrid working schedule that consists of three core in\-office/in\-person days (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday) and two non\-core days (Monday and Friday), with the option of being in the business office or remote. Ability to attend all home games and any mandatory events as well as away games, as necessary. A willingness to travel for other business\-related needs, as they arise. Ability to work at the team’s soccer operations office in Whippany, New Jersey, as needed. Gotham FC requires its associates to live in its market, that is, within reasonable commuting distance of Gotham FC’s offices, practice facility and Sports Illustrated Arena.  

Gotham FC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes everyone to our team. We are committed to broadening the pool of qualified talent for consideration, including those who have been historically underrepresented. We strongly encourage people of color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non\-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities to apply. **Job type:** Full\-time Non\-Exempt position  

**Salary range:** $20 Per Hour \+ Commission opportunities  

**Benefits**: Medical, Dental \& Vision benefit plans available for Employee and Family, Employee\-funded 401(k) option  


This job description is a broad summary of the essential job functions and general duties for this position, the additional job duties that may be required from time\-to\-time, the level of knowledge and skill typically required, and the scope of responsibility, but should not be considered an all\-inclusive listing of work requirements. The person in this role may be required to and must be willing to perform other duties as assigned to meet organizational needs. This job description may be modified from time to time, at the sole discretion of Gotham FC.  


This employee must follow and enforce all policies and procedures formulated by Gotham FC and be a role model for the organization.  


The existence of this job description does not modify the employee’s “at\-will” status. That is, unless a signed employment contract specifying a term of employment exists between Gotham FC and the employee or his/her/their representative, both Gotham FC and the employee will have the right to terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without reason or notice, unless otherwise prohibited by law.

**Entry Level Sales Representative**


**Build Your Career With Purpose**


At POWER, sales is more than closing deals \- it's about helping homeowners make confident decisions while building a career with unlimited growth potential. As a full\-time Sales Representative you'll receive hands\-on training, mentorship, and the tools you need to develop professionally, earn uncapped commissions, and make an impact from day one.


**How you’ll make an impact**


* Meet with homeowners to deliver engaging presentations on our energy\-efficient home remodeling products and services.

* Participate in weekly team meetings, training sessions, and collaborative learning opportunities.
* Contribute to a team culture built around mentorship, accountability, and celebrating success.

* Deliver exceptional customer experiences throughout every appointment.
* Consistently apply POWER’s sales process and product knowledge.
* Achieve individual sales goals while contributing to overall team success.
* Continue developing the skills needed for advancement within the organization.


**What It Takes To Succeed**


***You have these minimum qualifications:***


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence speaking with new people and presenting information.
* A self\-motivated mindset with a desire to learn and grow.
* Ability to work independently while thriving in a team environment.
* High school diploma or equivalent.


***It would be helpful if you have:***


* Previous experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, or another customer\-facing role.

* **Competitive Earning Potential** \- Earn $72,000 \- $130,000 each year paid at an hourly rate which includes uncapped commissions and bonuses

jobs.description:
**About Ande**  

We're a Series A startup building an AI\-native platform that connects Enterprises and Hospitality across the entire booking experience, backed by top\-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, and Bain Capital, and led by a serial entrepreneur with offices in NYC and SF. We help companies turn every dinner, event, and offsite into something effortless to plan and a breeze to manage, plugging right into the tools they already use.

**About the Role**  

You'll start the conversations that become Ande's enterprise deals. You'll research companies that spend on corporate entertainment, open conversations with the people who book and approve that spend, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives.


This is an in\-office role on a small, early sales team. You'll work day to day with the Enterprise GTM Lead and the AEs you support, and help shape the outbound playbook as we grow.

**What You'll Do**

* Prospect into enterprise accounts that fit Ande's ideal customer profile.
* Run outbound across email, phone and LinkedIn to the people who book and approve entertainment spend
* Use AI native tools to research every account before you reach out, so each message is specific to the person and their business.
* Book qualified meetings: an account that fits our profile, a conversation with a decision maker or key influencer, and an opportunity the AE moves to the qualified stage.
* Hand each meeting to the AE with clear context, and keep your activity and pipeline accurate in Salesforce.
* Work conferences and events with the team, and follow up on the contacts made there.
* Share what you hear from prospects, including which messages land and which don't, so we can sharpen targeting and messaging.
* Hit a quarterly qualified\-meeting target.

**What We're Looking For**

* Prospect into enterprise accounts that fit Ande's ideal customer profile.
* Run outbound across email, phone and LinkedIn to the people who book and approve entertainment spend
* Use AI native tools to research every account before you reach out, so each message is specific to the person and their business.
* Book qualified meetings: an account that fits our profile, a conversation with a decision maker or key influencer, and an opportunity the AE moves to the qualified stage.
* Hand each meeting to the AE with clear context, and keep your activity and pipeline accurate in Salesforce.
* Work conferences and events with the team, and follow up on the contacts made there.
* Share what you hear from prospects, including which messages land and which don't, so we can sharpen targeting and messaging.
* Hit a quarterly qualified\-meeting target.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience prospecting into procurement, events or field marketing teams.
* Familiarity with events, or travel and expense software.
* Hands\-on use of AI tools in your prospecting workflow.

jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**


Join Syneos Health in partnership with a large Biopharmaceutical company as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative (PSR). Become a part of a fast\-paced and challenging environment where our compassion and dedication drive us to meet the unique needs and goals of our customers. The PSR role is responsible for building relationships with recognized experts, healthcare providers (HCPs) and prioritized stakeholders.

**The successful PSR will:**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key accounts with the goal of maximizing sales
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action
* Deliver clinical brand specific presentations of product(s) to physicians and other appropriate health care professionals
* Develop a complete understanding of the health care delivery system within each assigned customer, including the physician hierarchy, key pharmacy personnel, clinical nursing staff, etc.
* Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends
* Analyze local trends, identifying long and short\-term goals to craft a strong product business plan
* Collaborate and partner with peers in the sales organization, brand team and other support partners to deliver an extraordinary customer experience
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner
* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area
* Participation in training and development programs
* Leverage AI\-driven insights and digital engagement tools to personalize healthcare provider interactions and improve customer experience.
* Adapt to emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and automation tools, to enhance productivity, customer engagement, and business outcomes.
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures

**Essential Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree required, Life Sciences preferred
* Business to business sales experience or internship experience and/or sales degree or 2\+ years of pharmaceutical experience
* Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication and influence prescribing habits
* Ability to learn, apply, and communicate products and disease states
* Proven track record of success in exceeding results
* Team player who can also work independently, highly collaborative and motivated to succeed
* Strong communication, business analytics and account management skills
* Strong digital acumen with an interest in adopting innovative technologies, including artificial intelligence, to drive performance and operational efficiency.

**Desired Requirements:**

* Cardiovascular Experience


The annual base salary for this position is **$60,000 – $90,000**. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include a company car or car allowance and eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and/or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

* Oversee and maintain each coding audit project, including establishing project timelines, ensuring client understanding of the audit process, setting up the appropriate tools required for the audit and communicating their use to the assigned auditors, monitoring the team’s trajectory toward achieving all deadlines, and routinely communicating audit project progress to Director and/or Manager, Audits as well as the client

jobs.description:
Convergint is looking for a full\-time, enthusiastic, results driven and forward\-thinking Project Coordinator to join our amazing culture. In this role, you will provide administrative support to the local office (CTC). As a Project Coordinator, you are a part of a dynamic team that allows you to grow as Convergint grows.

  


**For information about how we use your personal information, please see our Colleague \& Applicant Privacy Notice, available on convergint.com/careers.**

  





**Who You Are**



You have a passion for providing world\-class service to customers, colleagues, and communities. You are a person of integrity with a commitment to growth, accountability and delivering results. You want to join an organization with a positive culture that embraces equal opportunity and allows everyone to be the best version of themselves at work and home. You want to grow with us and deliver results as an exceptional Project Coordinator.

  


**Who We Are**



With 20\-years of proven growth and exceptional performance, our mission is to be our customer’s best service provider. We realize the importance of diversity in achieving that goal. Our company was built upon a solid foundation of 10 Values and Beliefs which drive our unmatched culture, making us the \#1 global, serviced\-based systems integrator in the industry. We take great pride in protecting the lives and assets of our customers and their communities with the solutions we provide.

  


**What you’ll do with “Our Training and Your Experience”**


* Convergint's greatest strength is our people! Every colleague is encouraged to participate in our Recruit Awesome People program, helping us grow Convergint by promoting our colleague\-first culture and referring top talent to the Talent Acquisition Team and hiring managers.
* Assist with project delivery and administration of multiple installation projects throughout their life cycle.
* Work with multiple Project Managers to ensure project delivery meets clients’ expectations and the project is completed on time and within budget.
* Administer project setup in financial system, project management application.
* Act as central information source by maintaining, communicating, and distributing project details in conjunction with company and client requirements.
* Follow up daily with project team members on uncompleted tasks and open issue logs.
* Document actions in project management application.
* Update project status with client on a regular basis.
* Research, compile, process and coordinate project data e.g. data entry, report generation, metrics collection.
* Use the financial system to monitor budget, actual project cost and cost commitments.
* Coordinate with other business areas such as Sales, Service, and Safety relating to project activities.
* Organize, administer, and maintain electronic, and hard copy filing systems in accordance with Convergint's record retention policies and procedures, including regular review of project files/folder structure and contents, archiving and preparation for project team use.
* Prepare Purchase Orders for project materials and coordinate orders with purchasing department.
* Work with Warehouse, Project Managers, Field Supervisors and Engineering for active tracking of material orders, delivery dates, and reconciliation of project material in warehouse.
* Prepare project invoices and work with the Project Managers and Accounts Receivable team with analysis and tracking of client invoices.
* Assist with project closeout documentation and project turnover to Service team for warranty and post\-installation support.

**Company Overview**

Landscape Studio Group is a design\-build landscape company serving high\-end residential homes throughout the Atlanta area. We create beautiful, functional outdoor spaces through innovative design, exceptional craftsmanship, and collaborative project execution. Our clients value attention to detail, clear communication, and a professional, personalized experience from start to finish.

As Production Coordinator, you will help deliver that experience through clear, proactive communication, thoughtful coordination, and strong relationships with homeowners, our internal team, and outside partners.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an energetic and detail\-oriented Landscape Construction Production Coordinator to support and coordinate our landscape construction projects.

This role works closely with and supports our current Production Manager, who leads field operations and manages the crews.

The Production Coordinator focuses on project planning, purchasing, job\-cost tracking, scheduling support, and customer communication, partnering with the Production Manager to keep projects organized and running smoothly.

You will coordinate project schedules and resources, keep customers and teammates informed, and help deliver exceptional results on time and within budget. Strong relationships, proactive communication, and consistent follow\-through are essential to success in this position.

**Responsibilities**

* Plan and coordinate high\-end residential landscape construction projects alongside the Production Manager, including materials, work sequences, schedules, and estimated crew days.
* Serve as a key point of contact for homeowners, providing proactive updates, answering questions, communicating schedule changes, and following through on concerns.
* Work closely with leadership, the Production Manager, and crews to keep project information accurate, priorities clear, and work moving efficiently.
* Review project plans and drawings to develop materials lists and ensure the team has current information.
* Order materials against approved estimates, confirm specifications and delivery dates, and flag potential budget overruns before purchases are made.
* Maintain accurate daily job\-cost records, including receipts, material purchases, and subcontractor expenses.
* Review labor hours against estimates weekly with the Production Manager and address variances while projects are underway.
* Coordinate subcontractor scopes, pricing, schedules, and insurance documentation.
* Schedule and track inspections, keeping customers and the field team informed of requirements and next steps.
* Identify potential problems early, communicate them clearly, and work collaboratively to find practical solutions.
* Learn and consistently use company\-selected software, internal systems, and AI tools to manage project information, communication, costs, and reporting.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Experience in landscape construction, residential construction coordination, or production administration.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the professionalism to work with homeowners who expect a high level of service and attention to detail.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build productive relationships with teammates, customers, subcontractors, and suppliers.
* Confidence handling challenging conversations about budgets, schedules, and expectations respectfully and constructively.
* Ability to read construction plans and drawings and develop accurate materials lists.
* Working knowledge of landscape construction materials, including stone, aggregate, pipe, plants, and pavers.
* Experience with purchasing, purchase orders, job costing, and tracking expenses against project budgets.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow\-through across multiple active projects.
* Ability to prioritize, adapt to changing schedules, and take initiative.
* Willingness to learn new technology and use the software, internal systems, and AI tools selected by the company. Prior experience with a specific platform is not required.
* Permitting and inspection experience in metro Atlanta and Spanish language skills are a plus.

At Landscape Studio Group, beautiful outdoor spaces start with great people working together. If you enjoy building relationships, keeping projects organized, and seeing thoughtful plans come to life, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager Telecom
jobs.description:
#### **About this Position**

At Henkel, you’ll be part of an organization that’s shaping the future through innovation, sustainability and collaboration. With our trusted brands like Persil®, ‘all®, Loctite®, Snuggle®, and Schwarzkopf® and our cutting\-edge technologies, you’ll have countless opportunities to explore new paths and grow.
  

  

This position is with our Adhesive Technologies business unit – where we empower our people to transform industries and provide our customers with a competitive advantage through adhesives, sealants and functional coatings.
  

  

**Dare to learn new skills, advance in your career and make an impact at Henkel.**  

  

#### **What you´ll do**

* Drive profitable growth as the key commercial lead within a regional, cross\-functional account team.
* Develop and execute the short\-, mid\-, and long\-term Key Account strategy aligned with business and sustainability priorities.
* Build deep and broad customer relationships across engineering, procurement, operations, and executive management.
* Translate customer strategy and technology priorities into joint innovation roadmaps and a strong project pipeline.
* Drive new opportunities from early specification and qualification through customer approval, commercialization, and revenue.
* Lead annual sales planning, forecasting, and long\-term growth plans, including revenue and profitability targets.
* Optimize account sales mix to accelerate growth and improve margins.
* Provide clear direction, priorities, and accountability across cross\-functional and regional account teams.
* Lead regular internal Key Account reviews and present strategic plans to executive stakeholders.
* Negotiate and secure strategic commercial agreements and long\-term customer partnerships.
* Advocate for account priorities in product development, innovation, supply, and investment decisions.
* Lead resolution of critical account issues, including supply disruptions, commercial challenges, and cross\-regional conflicts.
* Own overall account performance, customer satisfaction, and execution of the strategic account plan.

#### **What makes you a good fit**

* 7\+ years of experience in Key Account Management, business development, technical sales, or a related B2B role.
* Proven experience managing complex strategic accounts across engineering, procurement, operations, and senior management.
* Strong background in specification selling / design\-in, ideally within electronics, telecom or datacom, or industrial manufacturing.
* 5 years experience in Telecom preferred. Experience selling engineered materials, components, or technical solutions to OEMs, EMS manufacturers, or industrial customers.
* Proven ability to drive opportunities from early technical engagement through qualification, commercialization, and scale\-up.
* Strong value\-selling, account strategy, and pipeline management capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and executive levels.
* Strategic, analytical, hands\-on, and highly accountable. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, Business Administration, or related field.
* Willingness to travel approximately 40\-60% based on business needs. Travel will primarily be up and down the East Coast with occasional travel to include both Canada and Mexico.


#### **Some benefits of joining Henkel**

* Health Insurance: affordable plans for medical, dental, vision and wellbeing starting on day 1
* Work\-Life Balance: Paid time off including sick, vacation, holiday and volunteer time, flexible \& hybrid work policies (depending on role), and vacation buy / sell program
* Financial: 401k matching, employee share plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares, annual performance bonus, service awards and student loan reimbursement
* Family Support: 12\-week gender neutral parental leave (up to 20 weeks for parents giving birth), fertility support, adoption \& surrogacy reimbursement, discounted child and elderly care, and scholarships
* Career Growth: diverse national and international growth opportunities, access to thousands of skills development courses, and tuition reimbursement


The salary range for this role is $110,000\.00 and $145,000\.00\. This range represents the good‑faith minimum and maximum wages the Company reasonably expects to offer for this role at the time of posting. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for incentive pay or other forms of compensation, as applicable. The Company also offers a comprehensive benefits package as described above. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, experience, education, training, and work location. This posting is intended to comply with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws.  

  

Henkel does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Unsolicited referrals and resumes are considered Henkel property and therefore, Henkel will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited referral.  

  

At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Henkel is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, and other legally protected categories.

jobs.description:
***Please do not respond to direct messages with your personal information. All job applications and your sensitive, personal information should only be submitted via our official job platform.***

**Job Title: National Account Manager**

**Location: Remote (U.S.)**

**FLSA: Exempt**

**Company Overview:**


Safe\-Guard Product International serves Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), top retailers, and independent agents in the automotive finance and insurance industry with the leading Protection Products Platform. Our platform delivers innovative protection products and solutions that protect consumers from the perils of ownership, while providing Finance \& Insurance professionals the tools to ignite scalable and sustainable business growth. Safe\-Guard’s success is driven by over 850 employees, who serve more than 12,000 dealers and support contract holders across the U.S. and Canada.


For 30 years and counting, our team continues to transform the motor vehicle space, earning a stellar reputation from our partners and peers by providing: 1\) the highest quality protection products in the industry, 2\) a broad platform of branded product, technology, marketing, and training solutions, and 3\) an unwavering commitment to uncomplicated care and customer service.

**Role Overview:**


This role is about driving strategic growth across dealership groups nationwide by increasing F\&I product penetration, delivering impactful coaching, and strengthening Safe\-Guard’s position as a trusted partner. The purpose is to **drive F\&I product growth and profitability across dealership and group accounts** by delivering strategic training, coaching, and partner engagement. As a National Account Manager, you’ll engage directly with dealer group leadership and field teams to align on business goals, implement action plans, and ensure consistent execution across multiple rooftops. Your success is measured by the impact you make across every group you support.

**Role Responsibilities:**

**1\. STRATEGIC PARTNER LEADERSHIP (Biggest Impact on Performance)**

* **Strategic Partner Engagement:** Maintain regular contact with assigned dealer group leadership to align business goals, present performance insights, and position Safe\-Guard as a trusted advisor. This leads to long\-term retention and deeper product adoption.
* **Execute Group\-Level Account Plans:** Develop and implement strategic plans tailored to each dealer group, ensuring consistent execution and measurable outcomes across all locations.
* **Analyze and Report Performance Metrics:** Align with Dealer Groups on KPIs. Interpret **Growth Accelerator** data, track progress against KPIs, and share insights with internal teams and partners to drive continuous improvement.

**2\. REVENUE DRIVING \& EXECUTION**

* **Drive Product Penetration and Administration Fee Income:** Monitor and influence F\&I product sales and **Administration Fee** performance across rooftops, using data to guide action plans and coaching. This is the core revenue engine.
* **Deliver High\-Impact Coaching:** Facilitate or coordinate group\-wide training sessions, F\&I Roundtable, eCommerce Menu Utilization Training, maximize Dealer Participation Incentive Programs, Increase SG Express adoption.
* **Collaborate for Consistent Execution:** Work seamlessly with National Trainers, eCommerce, and National Vehicle Retailing Team, as well as Regional Performance / Account Development Managers to ensure consistent messaging, execution, and support across all rooftops.

**3\. ACCOUNT EFFICIENCY \& FOCUS**

* **Prioritize Visits:** Focus on **high\-impact partner engagement** and executive\-level planning ensuring maximum ROI on time or visits.
* **Leverage Support:** Outsource **routine administrative reporting** and engage with other internal support teams to assist with **store\-level training delivery** in an effort to free up time for high\-impact activities.
* **Proactive Engagement:** Establish proactive communication rhythms and empower field teams to handle tactical issues, avoiding **reactive support requests**.

**Qualifications:**

* **Top 3 Must\-Haves (Non\-Negotiable):**
	+ **Executive Presence and Relationship Intelligence:** The ability to build trust, influence dealer group leadership, and lead strategic conversations with confidence and credibility.
	+ **Proven Experience Driving F\&I Performance Across Groups:** A track record or potential to influencing decisions as a group level which increases **Product Penetration** and **Administration Fee** contribution across multi\-rooftop accounts.
	+ **Strategic Account Planning and Execution:** Demonstrated ability to develop and implement group\-level plans that align with partner goals, drive measurable outcomes, scale across rooftops, and able to confidently report back to Dealer Group executives.
* **Required Experience \& Knowledge:**

* **5\+ years** of Automotive Industry Experience (F\&I, OEM, or vendor\-side account management).
* **3–5 years** in Sales Leadership or Strategic Account Management, managing multi\-rooftop accounts.
* Deep understanding of **F\&I Product \& Performance Expertise**, **Dealer Group Operations**, **Menu Systems**, and **DMS Platforms**.
* **Strategic \& Tactical Thinking** and strong **Automotive Intellect**.
* **Tools \& Proficiency:**

* Proficiency in **CRM** and Sales Enablement Tools.
* Mastery or ability to quickly master Power BI, Excel, and **Growth Accelerator Reporting** to interpret performance data and action it.
* Skilled in using **Presentation \& Communication Platforms** (PowerPoint, Teams, etc) for executive\-level meetings.
* **Skills That Can Be Trained:** F\&I Product Knowledge, Safe\-Guard’s specific product suite, positioning strategies, and compliance nuances.

**Metrics of Success:**

* **F\&I Product Penetration Rate** and **Administration Fee Contribution** meet or exceed company objectives.
* **Growth Accelerator Performance** shows sustained improve

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
**Progressive Leasing** is a leading provider of in\-store and e\-commerce lease\-to\-own solutions. With more than 20 years in FinTech, we’ve grown from start\-up to industry leader by innovating, simplifying, and valuing people. We are a subsidiary of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), a FinTech holding company with three business segments: Progressive Leasing, Purchasing Power (a leading employee purchase program for consumer products and services using payroll deduction), and Four, a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) platform.

  

We are hiring a **Strategic Account Manager** that will serve as the trusted advisor and primary liaison to clients and brokers with the objectives of initiating and cultivating successful partnerships between Purchasing Power and key client accounts and brokers. The SAE will be responsible for the overall management of internal activities of a growing book of accounts within designated broker and client territories. This role will be accountable for the growth and increased profitability of existing business, assisting the acquisition of new business, and the strategic direction of assigned accounts and broker partnerships.

 *This is a hybrid role that requires in‑office presence in Atlanta, Georgia.*

 **WE ARE:** A collaborative, relationship\-driven team dedicated to building lasting partnerships with our clients and brokers. We work closely across sales, client services, marketing, and customer experience to grow Purchasing Power's voluntary benefit programs and deliver a best\-in\-class experience for every partner we serve.

 **YOU ARE:** A seasoned account management professional with a strong grasp of employee benefit programs and the financial acumen to drive revenue growth. You are a trusted advisor who builds credibility at the executive level, proactively identifies risks and opportunities, and communicates with confidence. You thrive in a goal\-driven environment and are comfortable owning relationships, making decisions, and partnering across teams to deliver meaningful outcomes.

 **YOUR DAY\-TO\-DAY:**

* Meet target revenue and revenue per eligible rates for each assigned account
* Represent Purchasing Power at the executive level of our clients and brokers to build strong relationships and educate each audience (broker, client, and consumer) on our value proposition
* Proactively offer guidance to help educate our broker and client partners on needed training programs
* Expand and cultivate each account and assigned broker region through frequent visits, ongoing communication, and accurate reporting
* Develop marketing opportunities for promotion to maximize program effectiveness for each account, utilizing broker portals and other communication tools available
* Ensure that account contract terms are adhered to and that all account needs are addressed
* Provide insight and information to cross\-functional internal departments to become a valuable resource and partner
* Understand account industry trends as well as voluntary benefit trends to identify new business opportunities with client and broker partners
* Proactively identify and report potential risks associated with each client and broker

Fine Fettle is a family owned, locally run multi\-state cannabis company with operations across Connecticut, Georgia, and Massachusetts. * Collaborate with retail leadership to support local store growth initiatives.

***Relationship Management:***

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Sales Professional, Restaurant Manager, Culinary Manager or Chef looking for career development opportunities? Join Freshpoint’s World Class Sales Team and explore all the benefits and perks.


**Why you should join our Sales Team:**

* Competitive base salary, bonus, plus promotional incentive opportunities
* Mileage reimbursement and cell phone provided
* Career pathing opportunities for both entry level, and experienced individuals
* Opportunity to be part of a purpose driven organization that supports communities and associates
* Specialized sales training
* Individual as well as team\-based selling
* Opportunity to learn different ethnic segments
* Monthly and annual sales rewards and recognition
* Robust benefits package including an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, \& 401(k) with automatic matching

**JOB SUMMARY**  

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. The main focus is to help Freshpoint customers succeed while achieving sales and profit goals established by the company. This position may require working some non\-traditional hours (evening, weekends, and holidays) to successfully meet customers' needs.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop new business, penetrate existing accounts, and minimize lost business to achieve profitable sales growth and special objectives within assigned territory.
* Seek and qualify prospects following company account stratification goals.
* Research customer business needs and develops a mix of products and service to meet needs.
* Evaluate market trends and recommend products to customers, based on business needs and goals.
* Be informed of market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales; share information with customers as part of value\-added services provided.
* Answer customers' questions about products, prices, availability, and product use.
* Provide product information and practical training to customer personnel.
* Drive personal vehicle to customer accounts, conventions, company meetings, etc.
* Communicate and collect accounts receivable as necessary, working with the credit department and client; collect all balances due based on approved credit terms.
* Manage deliveries to the routing schedule published by the transportation department; troubleshoot any problems that occur during the order process (for example, out of stock items, special order items, low inventory, etc.).
* Participate in company functions, promotions, customer visits, and customer events.
* Attend and participate in general sales and district meetings.
* Engage in ongoing training sessions.
* Assist with the training of new employees as requested.
* Review and analyze daily and weekly reports such as special\-order requests, customer bid files, and sales/gross profit margin data.
* Perform administrative duties, such as preparing sales budgets and reports, maintaining sales records, processing credits, and pick\-up requests, preparing sales quotes and menu suggestions, and filing reports.
* Other duties may be assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**  

**Education**


High School degree or equivalent

 **Experience**

* Minimum 2 years of sales, and/or chef/restaurant management experience, and/or related (Business, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality; or Culinary Arts) degree.
* 1 year of outside foodservice sales experience preferred
* Restaurant management / chef experience preferred

**Skills**

* Proficient in Excel, Word, Microsoft Outlook, and some knowledge of Salesforce a plus
* Working knowledge of warehouse distribution, a plus
* Good communication skills
* Detail\-oriented

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bi\-Lingual
* Restaurant Management, Foodservice Outside Sales, Chef Experience preferred

**Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations**

* Valid driver's license with a "clean" driving record (including no multiple DUIs within the last 2 years)
* Current automobile insurance with the following limits of liability: Bodily injury \- $100,000 each person and $300,000 each accident; property damage \- $100,000 is required

**Requirement**

* Submit to pre\-employment testing (Drug Screen, Background Check).
* Must sign Sysco Protective Covenants Agreement.
* Reside or willing to relocate to the geographical vicinity of territory.

 **Competencies**

* Building Trust
* Building Customer Loyalty
* Follow\-up
* Sales Ability / Persuasiveness
* Managing Work
* Adaptability
* Communication

jobs.title: Entry Level Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**$3,900 Sign\-On Bonus\***


**Entry Level Sales Representative**


**Build Your Career With Purpose**


At POWER, sales is more than closing deals \- it's about helping homeowners make confident decisions while building a career with unlimited growth potential. As a full\-time Sales Representative you'll receive hands\-on training, mentorship, and the tools you need to develop professionally, earn uncapped commissions, and make an impact from day one.


**How you’ll make an impact**


* Meet with homeowners to deliver engaging presentations on our energy\-efficient home remodeling products and services.
* Learn POWER’s proven sales process through ongoing training and coaching.
* Build meaningful relationships with customers by understanding their needs and recommending personalized solutions.
* Collaborate with teammates and mentors to continuously improve your sales approach.
* Develop communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills that prepare you for long\-term career growth.


**How you’ll partner with others**


* Partner with experienced sales leaders who will coach and support your development.
* Participate in weekly team meetings, training sessions, and collaborative learning opportunities.
* Contribute to a team culture built around mentorship, accountability, and celebrating success.


**What success looks like**


* Deliver exceptional customer experiences throughout every appointment.
* Consistently apply POWER’s sales process and product knowledge.
* Achieve individual sales goals while contributing to overall team success.
* Continue developing the skills needed for advancement within the organization.


**What It Takes To Succeed**


***You have these minimum qualifications:***


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence speaking with new people and presenting information.
* A self\-motivated mindset with a desire to learn and grow.
* Ability to work independently while thriving in a team environment.
* High school diploma or equivalent.


***It would be helpful if you have:***


* Previous experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, or another customer\-facing role.
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience delivering presentations or working toward performance\-based goals.


**Why You’ll Love Working Here**


At POWER, your success starts with our investment in you. From paid training and mentorship to comprehensive benefits and career advancement opportunities, we're committed to helping you build a rewarding long\-term career.


**Some of the benefits you’ll enjoy include:**


* **Competitive Earning Potential** \- Earn $72,000 \- $130,000 each year paid at an hourly rate which includes uncapped commissions and bonuses
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage** \- Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance plans designed to support you and your family.
* **Retirement Savings** \- Build your future with a 401(k) plan that includes company matching.
* **Paid Time Away** \- Take advantage of paid holidays and paid parental leave so you can focus on what matters most.
* **Wellness Support** \- Access to wellness programs that help you stay at your best.
* **Professional Development** \- Receive industry\-leading training, mentorship, leadership development, and ongoing opportunities for career growth.
* **Performance Recognition** \- Celebrate your success with incentive vacations, exclusive rewards, and recognition for top performance.
* **Tools For Success** \- Work with modern technology and resources that help you serve customers and maximize your potential.
* **An Inclusive Culture** \- Join a team that values diverse perspectives, supports employee resource groups, encourages veterans to apply, and is committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive.
* **Community Impact** \- Give back through volunteer opportunities and company initiatives that make a positive impact in the communities we serve.
* **Modern Workspaces** \- Collaborate in thoughtfully designed office spaces with opportunities for relocation as your career grows.


**Office Locations**


* Duluth, GA
* Marietta, GA

  




* *Power offers a $3,900 sign\-on bonus, which will be paid weekly in $325 increments over the course of twelve weeks of initial training. The full sign\-on bonus is contingent on successfully completing the twelve weeks of initial training.*

  


*Power Home Remodeling Group is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to hiring a diverse and talented workforce. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please submit the accommodation request to recruiting@powerhrg.com*

jobs.title: Commercial Sales Representative
jobs.description:
The Commercial Sales Representative identifies, develops, and maintains client relationships to drive revenue growth in the construction and paving industry. This position serves as the primary relationship owner for an assigned group of client accounts, with responsibility for retention, growth, and strategic business development.


The ideal candidate understands the full construction process — from bidding and estimating to project execution — and can effectively communicate the company’s capabilities to clients. This role requires excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build strong relationships at all levels of a client’s organization.


**Essential Job Duties \& Responsibilities:**


* Engage new and existing users to provide value around how users can be more successful with our current portfolio
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with current and potential clients, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and repeat business.
* Collaborate with estimating, operations, and project management teams to prepare accurate and competitive proposals.
* Participate in bid reviews and preconstruction meetings to align client expectations with project scope and company capabilities.
* Present proposals, negotiate contracts, and close deals with new and existing clients.
* Engage with clients regularly to understand their upcoming projects, challenges, and long\-term needs.
* Proactively and efficiently manage resources with dedicated teams, virtual teams, and executive staff around opportunities to ensure successful outcomes.
* Align the overall company solution to the customer’s business needs, challenges, and technical requirements.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills: writing, editing, and presenting.
* Ability to resolve complex problems.
* Build and maintain a consistently strong pipeline.
* Attend networking events, trade shows, and industry meetings to promote company services and strengthen client relationships.
* Provide feedback to management regarding market opportunities, client feedback, and operational improvements.
* Identify new and emerging vertical markets.
* Provide a consultative sales approach to clients.
* Excellent sales, negotiation, and team building skills and techniques are required.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.


**Qualifications (Experience, Education \& Certifications, Key Attributes):**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or relevant past experience in sales
* Experience as a direct contributor carrying an individual quota, experience selling construction services specifically asphalt or concrete is preferred.
* Ability and experience selling to Manager and Director levels within the organization
* Experience managing and directing the entire project cycle from beginning to close
* Candidate will be strategic in finding new business using technical knowledge and skillset
* Creation and execution of quarterly and annual business plans
* Good management presence, communication skills, and credibility
* Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding assigned annual/quarterly goals and targets
* Attentive to forecasting and business reporting responsibilities
* At least an intermediate level in using Microsoft Office products. Especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Technological orientation to utilize all software solutions for CRM, bid preparation and job cost.
